seen.where: Manus Online detail record Palagi Libri 432 ins. 64 (CNMD 0000173096), read via manus.iccu.sbn.it/o/manus-api (harvest copy research/sweep_2026-11_manus_italian_libs/_dl/detail.jsonl); no digital copy linked from the record; web search for Moreniana/Regione Toscana digitisation found none
seen.extent: Four of 22 letters in the insert, Mélanie Double to Guglielmo Libri: c. 1r-v (Paris, 1858), c. 9r-v, c. 11r-v, c. 18r-v (4 Feb 1857); ciphered passages are 'some lines' to 'the last part of the letter'; length per passage unknown
seen.cipher: Manus item notes quoted: c. 1r-v 'Parte della lettera è crittografata. In francese.'; c. 9r-v 'Alcune righe sono crittografate. In francese.'; c. 11r-v 'Alcune righe sono crittografate. In francese.'; c. 18r-v 'L'ultima parte della lettera è cifrata; nel testo alcuni nomi di persona sono indicati con numeri.' The leaves were not seen and the system is unknown; the record gives no decipherment.

prior_art.decode: Not seen on DECODE: known.py on Libri, Mélanie Double, Palagi Libri and Carte Libri found only this lead and the sweep files; web search for Libri with DECODE returned only Mary Stuart/DECODE general pages, no Libri record.
prior_art.tomokiyo: No Cryptiana post found: searches (Libri Moreniana cipher; Tomokiyo Libri) returned only unrelated Cryptiana pages (Mary Stuart, Venetian 1552); nothing on Libri.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry work on Libri found; the search returned Lasry's Mary Stuart papers and nothing on 19th-century Libri letters.
prior_art.edition: No edition of Mélanie Double's letters found; searches for Libri correspondence (Maccioni Ruju-Mostert 1995 biography, Verloren; Wikipedia; AIM25 Libri letter 1857) mention no cipher, and the biography itself was not consulted.
prior_art.literature: Searches (Italian/French/English: Libri, Double, chiffre/cifra/cipher, Moreniana digitisation) found no study of Libri's code; Manus records are the only source naming the ciphered passages.

2445.key_check: No key held or in print for the Double letters. Searched the repo (known.py) and the web; no decipherment of Libri's system found; none could be applied since the leaves are not seen.
2445.key_in_volume: Possible key material is in a different unit: Carte Libri 9, cc. 37r-38v (Manus record 618317, Libri's letter in Italian, 1821-1830 est.): 'Nella colonna di sinistra alcune annotazioni scritte secondo il sistema crittografico messo a punto dal Libri.' Not seen, not tested; same system as the 1850s letters is only a guess.
2445.duplicates: known.py with Libri, Mélanie Double, Melanie Double, Palagi Libri 432, Carte Libri 9 and Double: no catalogue or lead entry for these letters other than this lead (id 2445); no other Libri cipher record found.
